text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=inference-runtime · alert=latency_p99_eu-west · severity=sev2 · link=https://pagerduty.example/INC/PD-8765 · details: p99(5m)=1124ms (threshold=800ms) · window=5m · @channel
Maya K: acknowledging, I'm oncall and taking. Starting triage now.
Sanjay R: thx @Maya. saw a smaller spike in APAC last night — that was kvcache evictions + sidecar throttling. worth checking redis evictions and sidecar logs.
Maya K: looking at console -> EU-WEST cluster. p95 ~120ms, p99 ~1124ms. error rate for http 500s up ~0.7% in last 5m. no bulk errors, mostly timeouts.
Maya K: quick check pods and nodes:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
NAME                                      READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   IP           NODE
inference-runtime-5d4b8c7f6-abcde         1/1     Running   0          4d    10.2.3.12    gke-eu-west-01
inference-runtime-5d4b8c7f6-fghij         1/1     Running   0          4d    10.2.3.13    gke-eu-west-02
inference-sidecar-xyz-123                 1/1     Running   1          2d    10.2.3.20    gke-eu-west-02
```
Maya K: redis kvcache evictions spiked:
```
$ redis-cli -h redis-eu info stats | grep evicted_keys
evicted_keys:12456
```
Sanjay R: yep that's the signal. evictions => more cold requests hitting model which raises GPU memory pressure and latency tails. Check GPU mem usage and telemetry.
Maya K: GPU mem on node gke-eu-west-01 at 92% on the hot pod. sidecar logs show intermittent OOM proxies and reconnects.
ops-runbook-bot: runbook: https://runbook.example/inference/latency-kvcache · recommended steps: 1) scale replicas 2) increase kvcache memory 3) roll sidecar 1 pod to verify
Maya K: doing step 1 now — scaling inference-runtime from 4->6 replicas to relieve per-pod pressure.
```
$ kubectl scale deploy inference-runtime -n inference --replicas=6
deployment.apps/inference-runtime scaled
```
Aisha L: acked PD and joining. I'll take step 3 (rolling sidecar restarts) once Maya confirms scale event effect. Also can bump redis maxmemory-policy if needed.
Maya K: scale confirmed, new pods coming up. routing shows warmup traffic pattern; warming KV cache should help within ~6-8m.
Sanjay R: if p99 doesn't drop in 10m, we should consider temporary traffic split (route 20% -> eu-central fallback) to protect customer experience.
Leo (infra): I can cut a quick route change on the router if requested. needs explicit approval from oncall.
Maya K: approve 20% shift if p99 stays >800ms after scale+warm. For now watching.
Aisha L: starting a rolling restart of sidecar on one pod to test — will verify metrics after each restart.
```
$ kubectl rollout restart daemonset inference-sidecar -n inference --selector=zone=eu-west --record
```
Maya K: customer-impact summary for incident channel: user-facing latency increase in EU-WEST causing ~0.7% elevated request timeouts and sporadic 500s. Impact class: degraded performance, partial (not global outage). SLA risk: p99 breach, needs mitigation to avoid escalation to sev1.
Sanjay R: agreed. notify customer success if we need >30min mitigation window.
Aisha L: after one sidecar restart: sidecar log sessions look stable; redis evictions trending down, evicted_keys now 11230.
Maya K: p99 trending down -> 540ms at 15m after scale. still above 800 earlier but improving.
Maya K: starting warmup job to prefill kvcache for top prefixes (quick script run).
```
$ python tools/prefill_kvcache.py --top-keys=10000 --region=eu-west
prefill started -> approx 8m to complete
```
Leo (infra): prepping route change if needed; will standby to move 20% traffic to eu-central.
Aisha L: if after prefill p99 still >800ms, I'll request Leo to split traffic.
Maya K: 30m check: p99=340ms, p95=110ms, errors back to baseline 0.1%. redis evictions falling to expected rate.
Maya K: marking PD as resolved/closed, will keep this thread open for 30m to monitor and then file postmortem with timeline + mitigation notes. good job team :thumbsup:
Sanjay R: nice work. Recommend follow-up: increase kvcache capacity for eu-west, tune sidecar restart backoff, add alert for evicted_keys spike to catch this earlier.
Aisha L: will create follow-up ticket for kvcache sizing + runbook tweak.
Maya K: handing off monitoring to Aisha for the next 30m then will update incident tracker. Handoff ETA 30m.
ops-runbook-bot: incident note appended: incident_type=latency_slo_burn · root_cause_candidate=kvcache_evictions + sidecar instability · mitigations_applied=[scale_replicas, sidecar_roll, kvcache_prefill] · postmortem_ticket=TRACKER-789
Leo (infra): standby released.
Maya K: last check (closing): p99 stable=310ms · closing thread for now.
